We announce the release of Marvelous Designer 8 for Steam 4.2.299.41342.

[Fixed]
- Login issue that occurs when enabling the firewall option in OnlineAuth version.
- A new feature dialog persists after clicking on the 'don't show again' checkbox in the dialog.
- Crash that occurs when using the application with AMD Graphics card with VBO option enabled and clicking an object in 3D window.(This issue may persist with a few AMD Graphics cards or drivers.)

If you have any inquiries, feel free to contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com.

notes.title: [Notice] Marvelous Designer 8 Steam version release
notes.notes:
Dear users,

We proudly present Marvelous Designer 8 steam today.
Version 8 including the following features.

- Remeshing (beta)
- 3D sewing
- Sculpt mode
- Trace Patterns with UV Map
- Adjust Trim Weight
- Automated Arrangement point creation
- and more 

As we announced, Marvelous Designer 7 steam users will receive loyalty coupon for version 8. 

If you need more info, please feel free to contact us by support@marvelousdesigner.com

All the best,
Marvelous Designer Team.
